events.label: documented
events.text: Island name appeared in a sailing directions book.

evidence.quote: The name Shelter island also appeared in a book for sailing directions that published in 1863

events.label: documented
events.text: Island appeared on Volonteri's map, marked Ngau Tau Chü.

evidence.quote: The island appeared in a map drawn by Father Simeone Volonteri in 1866

events.text: Region containing the island ceded to Colony of Hong Kong.

evidence.quote: The island was part of a larger region that ceded to the Colony of Hong Kong in 1898

events.label: documented
events.text: Island described as high in Asiatic Pilot publication.

evidence.quote: In Asiatic Pilot by the U.S . Hydrographic Office in 1910

events.label: incident
events.text: Mortar shell discovered on a beach of the island.

evidence.quote: In 2011 , a mortar shell was discovered on a beach of the island

events.label: proposal
events.text: Country and Marine Parks Board proposed a marine park including the island; not realized.

evidence.quote: was proposed by the Country and Marine Parks Board , a consultative body for the government in 2014

events.label: proposal
events.text: WWF proposed Port Shelter Marine Protected Area including the island.

evidence.quote: In 2018 , World Wide Fund for Nature also proposed to establish the Port Shelter Marine Protected Area

undated_mentions: Island used by a drug lord and associates to hide goods (1970s)
District administration transferred to Sai Kung District Office after World War II
